function.name: add_todo
function.description: Adds a new todo item to the todo.csv file with auto-generated ID, timestamp, and pending status.

todo_text.description: The text content of the todo item to be added.

path.description: The file path to the todo.csv file. If not provided, the default path will be used.

function.name: delete_todo
function.description: Deletes a todo item from the todo.csv file by its ID. Returns True if deletion was successful, False otherwise.

todo_id.description: The ID of the todo item to delete.

path.description: Optional file path to the todo.csv file.

function.name: calculate_gcd
function.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor (GCD) of a list of integers. Returns the GCD as an integer, or False for invalid input as required by test cases.

numbers.description: A list of integers for which to calculate the GCD.

function.name: find_helping_todos
function.description: Finds todo items whose task contains any of the given helper verbs as whole words, case-insensitive. Returns a list of matching todo dicts, an empty list if no matches or empty verbs, and False on invalid input or file errors.

verbs.description: A list of helper verbs to search for in each todo task.

path.description: Optional file path to the todo CSV file. Defaults to the default CSV path if not provided.
